tasks.short: Reconcile monthly pay to the Rabobank statement and finish the close pack.

today.trigger: The monthly payroll in AFAS Profit is final and Rabobank has posted the salary batch, or the controller asks for the payroll close pack.
steps: Export the payroll journal, the net-pay control total and the SEPA batch details from AFAS Profit.
Download the Rabobank statement and tick the salary batch, returned payments and attachment-of-earnings payments off against it.
Rebuild the same tie-out in Excel when one batch has become several bank lines.
Write a short period pack for the controller and file it on SharePoint.
Chase rejected IBANs and site payroll contacts until the open amount is explained.
drudgery: Downloading the same statement and journal every month
Matching batch totals by eye or with lookups
Rebuilding the close pack from last month's workbook
today.time_sinks: Split batches, next-day value dates, loonbeslag payments to third parties, and rejected employee IBANs keep a balanced payroll from looking balanced on the bank statement.

lenses.faster: The batch-to-statement match and the standard close pack are produced as soon as both files exist, so the specialist no longer spends the cycle on lines that already agree.
lenses.autonomous: Each posted payroll and each imported Rabobank statement starts the match and either clears the period or opens an aged break list, with no reminder from the controller.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the effort the company would reconcile every off-cycle correction and every site batch in the same week, and would keep pension and wage-tax payments on the same pack.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses the cent-hunting in Excel. What remains is a real break: someone was not paid, or money left the account for the wrong party.
lenses.options: The same month can be shown by site, by SEPA batch, by wage component, as unmatched items only, and against the prior period, all from one match.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the match rules, the tolerance and the reason codes the controller relies on, and reviews breaks rather than rebuilding the tie-out.
reach: The bookkeeper's match of the net-pay batch to the bank statement
The accountant's first look at the payroll journal in the month close
Chasing rejected salary payments that now bounce between payroll, the sites and the bank

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a difference is timing, a loonbeslag payment, or a missing employee, and standing behind the pack the controller books.
tasks.pattern_why: The inputs are structured, the rule is equality of amount, batch and value date, and a second person can recheck the matched and unmatched lists. Ordinary software can do that every month with no model in the run.

in_practice.trigger: A payroll journal posts in AFAS Profit or a Rabobank statement file is imported.
steps: Load the payroll control totals, the SEPA batch status and the bank statement lines.
Match amount, batch reference and value date, including known splits for attachments of earnings.
Clear exact matches and place every other line on an aged break list with a suggested reason.
The specialist codes, clears or chases each break.
Write the month pack to the SharePoint close folder once the breaks are explained.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist clears every unmatched item before the controller treats the period as balanced. A fully matched period does not need a line-by-line signature.
data_needed: Payroll journal and net-pay total by batch and by site
SEPA batch id, status and value date
Rabobank statement lines
Loonbeslag and other third-party payroll payments
Open IBAN rejects from prior periods
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS matching log and the payroll close folder on SharePoint

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit Finance can import Dutch bank statements and match them to open items.
Rabobank business banking supplies statement files and status for SEPA salary batches.
Auto-clearing exact payroll batch totals and listing only breaks would remove most of a monthly Excel tie-out at a company of this size.

risks: A batch that matches in total can still hide one underpaid employee and one overpaid employee.
Loonbeslag payments and rejected IBANs will keep creating breaks that look like errors if the rules ignore them.
Agency invoices are not Noordhaven net pay; mixing them into this match will make the pack wrong.
Bank and pay files contain IBANs and net pay, so the matcher has to stay inside the company tenant under AVG.
research_questions: In the last six months, what share of salary payments already matched a single Rabobank line inside AFAS with no Excel?
How often is the salary run split across sites, correction batches, loonbeslag and rejected payments?
Will the controller accept a system pack as the period-end payroll report if every break is aged and explained?

tasks.short: Run monthly pay, publish the payslips and send the Rabobank file.

today.trigger: The monthly pay calendar, plus joiners, leavers and hour files from Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.
steps: Collect mutations from HR administration and hour and allowance files from the three sites.
Run a concept payroll in AFAS Profit under the transport CAO and the warehouse CAO.
Review warnings and sample payslips, especially night shifts, overtime, sick pay and leavers.
Correct errors and rerun until the control totals look right.
Publish loonstroken to the employee portal and send the SEPA file to Rabobank.
Deal with rejected payments and the first 'my payslip is wrong' mail.
drudgery: Chasing late hour files in different layouts per site
Re-reading long warning lists and sampling payslips the system has already calculated
Retyping the same joiner and leaver checks each month
today.time_sinks: Warehouse hours and shift allowances arrive late and coded differently per site, so the concept run is repeated and the payment file waits on a few unresolved people.

lenses.faster: The concept run, the warning list and the payment file are ready before the specialist sits down, and clean employees drop out of the review.
lenses.autonomous: Once site hours and HR mutations are in, the concept payroll and the exception list start on the pay calendar without a manual kickoff.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost every joiner would be paid correctly in week one, and every shift allowance under both CAOs would be right the first time, which is part of keeping people past day 90.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses sampling stacks of correct payslips. What people like is a leaver, a long-term sick colleague or an attachment of earnings handled carefully.
lenses.options: Before release, five slices are available: by site, by CAO, outliers against last month, joiners and leavers only, and employees on sick pay.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the pre-release checks and the sample rules, and spends the cycle on exceptions and the release itself.
reach: The HR administrator's check that a joiner's scale, hours, tax credit and IBAN are complete before first pay
The compensation specialist's monthly test that allowances in the run match current CAO scales
The bookkeeper's upload of an already approved salary file to Rabobank

tasks.human_edge: Authorising the payment. A wrong scale, a missed leaver or a broken beslagvrije voet is the specialist's decision, and warehouse staff trust a named person for that.
tasks.pattern_why: AFAS already calculates the pay. The remaining work crosses hour files, a concept run, warnings and Rabobank, and it counts only when a person releases the money. An agent can prepare that path; the release stays human.

in_practice.trigger: The pay calendar date is reached and site hours plus HR mutations are marked complete in AFAS Profit.
steps: Start the concept payroll for both CAOs and build a warning list: missing IBAN, minimum wage, odd net pay, sick-pay percentage, leavers, loonbeslag.
Compare control totals and headcount with last month by site and flag only the movements.
The specialist works the warning list and a set sample of night shift, driver, part-time office and long-term sick payslips.
The specialist publishes loonstroken and approves the SEPA file for Rabobank.
Returned payments open a case per employee instead of a full rerun.
in_practice.human_gate: The payroll specialist approves the SEPA file and publication of the payslips. A second approver joins that release where the company already requires one. The model does not change a wage component.
data_needed: Approved hours, overtime and shift allowances by employee and site
Joiners, leavers, contract changes, tax credit and IBAN
Sickness and leave from the absence records
Active loonbeslag and the protected minimum pay
Current wage scales for both CAOs
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS payroll approval log and a pay-run note in the SharePoint payroll folder

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit calculates Dutch payroll, produces loonstroken and creates a SEPA payment file.
Monthly pay for staff on a Dutch CAO, including allowances and sick pay, is normally calculated in the payroll system from structured inputs.
Employers keep a human release of the salary payment file even when calculation is fully in software.

risks: Bad warehouse hours become a clean-looking payment if the check only looks at payroll totals.
Two CAOs with different allowances will be mis-applied if employees are on the wrong agreement in AFAS.
An attachment of earnings that leaves less than the beslagvrije voet harms the employee immediately.

A tool that proposed individual wage changes could fall under the EU AI Act employment provisions and would need a DPIA and works-council consent before use. A check list with human release is the safer scope.
BSN, sick pay and net pay must not be pasted into a consumer chatbot.
research_questions: Where do Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo hours and allowances enter today, and how stable are the codes?
What share of last year's payslip complaints were input errors, CAO rules, or AFAS setup?
Who is allowed to release the SEPA file today, and is a second signature already required?
Would the works council expect to consent before any new tool reads pay and absence data?

tasks.short: Compile the pay and benefits figures the other departments ask for.

today.trigger: Month close, or a request from the HR director, FP&A, the controller or a site manager.
steps: Pull wage components, headcount and employer charges from AFAS Profit, often via the nightly extract.
Rebuild cuts in Excel because the Power BI dashboards do not match the question.
Split transport CAO, warehouse CAO and office staff, and add holiday allowance and sick-pay cost when asked.
Send the workbook by mail and answer definition questions in Teams.
drudgery: Rebuilding the same pivot with a new month on the end
Explaining again which components sit inside 'wage cost'
Copying figures into someone else's slide or workbook
today.time_sinks: HR and finance use different definitions of overtime, sick pay and holiday allowance, so every request becomes a reconciliation before it becomes a report.

lenses.faster: The standard cuts refresh with the nightly AFAS extract, and the specialist stops re-exporting them.
lenses.autonomous: After each closed payroll the agreed packs for HR, FP&A and the controller update themselves and land in the shared folder.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost Noordhaven would publish a weekly labour-cost flash by site, shift and CAO, including sick pay and allowance drift, so managers see a problem before month end.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses maintaining the shadow workbook. What remains is explaining a real movement, such as a night-shift spike in Tilburg.
lenses.options: Five cuts stay available from the same definitions: site, CAO, wage component, contract type, and variance to the FP&A budget.
lenses.altitude: The specialist, with the people-analytics analyst, owns the definitions in Power BI and stops being the export desk.
reach: The FP&A analyst's monthly actuals for wage cost, overtime and allowances
The people-analytics analyst's standard pay extracts, on one shared definition
A site note on overtime and sick-pay cost the HR business partner can take to a manager

tasks.human_edge: Choosing the definition HR and finance will both use, and saying whether a movement is a roster change, a CAO item or a data error.
tasks.pattern_why: The figures already sit in AFAS and in the nightly extract. Fixed measures that tie back to the payroll journal can refresh without a model. Commentary can be variance lines from those measures.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly Power BI refresh after a payroll is closed, and the monthly calendar for HR, FP&A and the controller.
steps: Publish the agreed measures from the AFAS extract: gross, employer charges, overtime, shift allowances, sick pay, holiday-allowance accrual, headcount, by site and CAO.
Tie each pack back to the payroll journal and show a break if it does not.
Refresh the five standard cuts and the budget variance.
The specialist reviews only packs that do not tie, or new definitions, before they are shared.
Store the pack next to the month-close folder on SharePoint.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves a new or changed definition before it is used in a pack that goes to HR or finance. An unchanged pack that ties to the journal can publish on the nightly refresh.
data_needed: Wage components and employer charges by employee, site, CAO and period
Headcount and contract type
FP&A budget lines for labour cost
A written definition list signed off by payroll, HR and finance
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI dataset refresh history and the definition sheet in the SharePoint payroll folder

evidence.claim: Power BI can hold standard payroll measures on a scheduled refresh from a finance or HR extract.
Noordhaven already refreshes HR and finance dashboards from a nightly AFAS extract, so the data path for a payroll pack exists.
Parallel Excel continues where HR and finance have not agreed definitions, even after a dashboard is live.

risks: A prettier dashboard with two definitions of wage cost will increase arguments rather than remove the workbook.
Agency labour sits in the staffing portals and accounts payable, not in AFAS payroll; folding it into these packs without a source will mislead FP&A.
Employee-level extracts in Power BI widen access to pay data and need the existing AVG role design, not a shared mailbox file.
research_questions: Which recurring packs does payroll still build in Excel, and which questions are already answered in Power BI?
Do HR, FP&A and the controller agree what is inside overtime, sick pay and holiday allowance?
Are agency hours and invoices being requested inside this task, and if so who owns those figures today?

tasks.short: Balance the payroll cash and ledger accounts to the cent.

today.trigger: The payroll journal has posted in AFAS finance, or a wage-tax, pension or net-pay payment has left Rabobank.
steps: Open the payroll balance-sheet accounts: net wages, wage tax, pension, holiday-allowance accrual, advances and loonbeslag.
Tick each account off to the payroll subledger, the payment batches and the latest invoices from the pension side.
Park unexplained differences in an Excel tie-out.
Ask the controller or a bookkeeper which differences can wait until next month.
drudgery: Ticking the same accounts every month
Searching for a wage component that was never mapped to the ledger
Copying opening balances into a new workbook
today.time_sinks: New allowance codes, May holiday-allowance payout, and payments that hit the bank in a different period from the journal create differences that are real but boring to explain.

lenses.faster: Each payroll account is tied to the subledger as the journal posts, so the specialist opens an aged list rather than a blank workbook.
lenses.autonomous: Every payroll journal and every related Rabobank payment starts a balance check and assigns an owner to anything that does not tie.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost every payroll account would stay aged weekly, including attachments, advances and the holiday-allowance accrual, and year-end would not be the first full tie-out.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses the reconciliation workbook. What remains is an unmapped component or a payment that went to the wrong account.
lenses.options: Breaks can be sorted by euro amount, by age, by site and by wage component, with a separate view for the holiday-allowance accrual.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the wage-component-to-ledger map and the ageing rules, together with the controller, and stops reperforming the tick-and-tie.
reach: The accountant's tie-out of wage-tax, pension and holiday-allowance balances
The bookkeeper's clearing of payroll suspense and loonbeslag payments
The controller's question list on payroll balances during the close

tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a new allowance's ledger mapping is correct, and which old difference is safe to leave open. That judgment stays with payroll and the controller.
tasks.pattern_why: AFAS already posts payroll into its own ledger. Comparing each control account with the subledger and the payment is a rule with a checkable difference. The gain is smaller than a fresh bank match because much of the posting is already in the system; the shadow workbook is what can go.

in_practice.trigger: A payroll journal posts, or a net-pay, wage-tax or pension payment is booked from Rabobank.
steps: Compare each payroll balance-sheet account with the payroll subledger and the related payments.
Auto-clear zero differences and list the rest with age, amount and likely cause, including unmapped wage components.
The specialist reviews the list, fixes the mapping or chases the payment.
Changes to the component-to-ledger map are approved before the next run.
The aged list is stored with the month-close pack.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist and the controller approve mapping changes and any difference that will be written off or left past the close. Zero-difference accounts do not need a signature.
data_needed: Chart of payroll-related ledger accounts and the wage-component map
Payroll subledger by component and period
Payment dates for net pay, loonheffingen and pension
Holiday-allowance accrual and payout entries
Open advances and loonbeslag balances
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS finance log and the payroll balance-sheet tie-out in the SharePoint close folder

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit posts the payroll journal into the same product's general ledger, so subledger and ledger share one source.
AFAS Finance includes bank and ledger matching for open items.
Residual payroll-account differences in Dutch companies commonly come from unmapped components, payment timing, attachments of earnings and the holiday-allowance cycle.

risks: Auto-clearing a zero at account level can hide a wrong mapping that nets off inside the same account.
If new allowance codes appear every CAO change and nobody owns the map, the exception list will stay red and the workbook will return.
This tie-out overlaps the bank match; running both as separate projects will duplicate work for the same FTE.
research_questions: How many hours a month are still spent in an Excel balance-sheet tie-out, versus inside AFAS afletteren?
How often does a new wage component post to the wrong ledger account or to none?
Which payroll accounts does the controller still not trust at close?

tasks.short: Put through pay corrections and retroactive CAO increases.

today.trigger: An employee or manager reports a pay error, or a new CAO scale must be paid with a backdated effective date.
steps: Read the mail, the CAO note or the ticket and work out who is affected and for which months.
Build or check a population in Excel, often separately for the transport CAO and the warehouse CAO.
Run an AFAS correction (nacalculatie) and sample old versus new gross, pensionable wage and net.
Ask Compensation and Benefits when the CAO text is ambiguous.
Post the correction, release the adjusted payslips and answer questions from the sites.
drudgery: Building the in-scope population by hand
Recalculating the same employee three times in a spreadsheet beside AFAS
Copying explanation lines into individual replies
today.time_sinks: Retroactive CAO increases hit hundreds of shift workers at once, and each one also moves holiday allowance, pensionable wage and sometimes sick pay.

lenses.faster: Scope, prior-period recalculation and sample payslips are drafted before the specialist checks them, so the spreadsheet rebuild disappears.
lenses.autonomous: A logged pay-error ticket or a stored CAO change starts the population and the concept correction without waiting for a quiet week.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost every CAO increase would be costed properly before it is announced, and ordinary errors would be corrected in the next run as a matter of course.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses the 1,200-line retro spreadsheet. People do like being able to tell a driver exactly why back pay landed in this month's net.
lenses.options: For a collective increase, three worked scenarios are ready for Compensation and Benefits: pay all arrears in one period, spread them, and include or exclude pensionable wage, each with cost and sample net pay.
lenses.altitude: The specialist keeps the correction rules and the test profiles for both CAOs, and checks scope and samples rather than calculating each arrears line.
reach: The compensation specialist's first calculation of cost and net-pay effect for a CAO increase
The HR administrator's mass update of scales and steps
The first explanation of a back-pay line to a site manager, before it becomes an HR business-partner case

tasks.human_edge: Reading the CAO article next to the contract and deciding whether this is a correction or a new term that Compensation and Benefits must own. Collective changes are not posted on a model reading of a PDF.
tasks.pattern_why: The instruction often arrives as a mail or a CAO text, while the money calculation is a structured AFAS correction. Several steps and a wrong-scope risk sit between the two, so a person approves the population and the posting.

in_practice.trigger: A pay-error case is logged, or Compensation and Benefits stores a CAO change with an effective date.
steps: Turn the instruction into a draft scope: population, periods, wage components, and whether pensionable wage and holiday allowance move.
Run an AFAS concept correction and produce old-versus-new gross, tax, pension and net.
Show sample profiles: warehouse night shift, driver, part-time office, long-term sick.
Compensation and Benefits confirms scope when the change is collective; the specialist confirms individual errors.
Post the approved correction, publish the payslip lines, and log the case.
in_practice.human_gate: Nothing posts without the payroll specialist's approval. A collective CAO change also needs Compensation and Benefits to confirm the reading of the agreement before the run.
data_needed: CAO article or written instruction and effective date
Employee agreement type, scale, step, hours and site
Prior-period wage components and what was already paid
Flags for pensionable wage, holiday allowance and sick-pay base
Sample profiles agreed with Compensation and Benefits
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS correction log and a case note on SharePoint, with the instruction and the approval attached

evidence.claim: AFAS payroll can recalculate earlier periods and pay the difference in the current period.
Dutch sector CAOs, including goods transport, often settle wage increases with a retroactive effective date.
Turning a CAO text into a population and a pensionable-wage choice is a specialist check before posting.

risks: A wrong population pays arrears to the wrong CAO group or misses a site, and trust is hard to win back.
Back pay can change pension base, holiday allowance and the employee's yearly wage statement.
Sickness-related corrections reveal health data; those cases need a tighter access path under AVG.
Letting a model set individual pay would raise EU AI Act and works-council questions. Keeping AFAS as the calculator and a person as the approver limits that.
Side letters and local customs may not be in the CAO PDF the model sees.
research_questions: How many individual corrections and how many collective retros did payroll process in the last year, and how long did each take?
Does Compensation and Benefits already keep a written rule for pensionable wage and holiday allowance on back pay?
Will Compensation and Benefits accept a draft population from the CAO text as a starting point they must still sign?

tasks.short: Prepare the monthly loonaangifte and send it to the Belastingdienst.

today.trigger: The payroll period is closed, on the calendar ahead of the Belastingdienst filing and payment deadline.
steps: Let AFAS Profit build the loonaangifte from the closed payroll.
Compare wage tax, employee-insurance premiums and the employer health-insurance contribution with the payroll journal and with last month.
Fix rejections: BSN, date of birth, address, or a negative amount.
Send the return through Digipoort and arrange the loonheffingen payment via Rabobank.
Track Belastingdienst signals and, when needed, a correction return.
drudgery: Cross-adding the return to the journal on a checklist
Retyping payment details that already sit on the return
Keeping a private log of signals and corrections
today.time_sinks: A CAO retro, a heavy sickness month or a December extra makes the delta look wrong, and a rejected BSN blocks a clean send.

lenses.faster: The cross-add to the journal and the period-on-period delta are done before the specialist opens the return, so preparation is a review of flags.
lenses.autonomous: Closing the payroll starts the concept return and the checks, and the specialist gets one queue: deltas, rejections and the payment amount.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost correction returns would go out within days of an error, and wage-tax payable versus payments would stay visible all year, not only at the jaaropgave.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses the checklist arithmetic. The specialist still owns the moment the return is sent and any letter from the Belastingdienst.
lenses.options: Before a correction is sent, two or three timings are shown: correct this period, send a later correctiebericht, or wait for the next regular return, with the effect on payable and on the employee jaaropgave.
lenses.altitude: The specialist maintains the pre-send checks and the filing calendar, and reviews exceptions, rather than assembling the return.
reach: The accountant's watch on wage-tax payable and the payment to the Belastingdienst
The year-end tie from payroll tax to the jaaropgaven, with the controller
A short note to FP&A when a retro or a sickness spike changes employer charges

tasks.human_edge: The employer stays responsible for the loonaangifte. The specialist is the person who can explain a spike and who decides that this version is the one that goes to the Belastingdienst.
tasks.pattern_why: AFAS already builds a structured message from the closed payroll. Totals, BSN checks and deltas versus last month are rules with a pass or fail. A model is not required to fill the form, and a person still sends it.

in_practice.trigger: The payroll period is marked closed in AFAS Profit.
steps: Build the concept loonaangifte in AFAS from that period.
Run checks: tie to the payroll journal, delta versus last period, invalid BSN or dates, and amounts that Digipoort commonly rejects.
The specialist reviews every flag and every material delta.
The specialist sends the return via Digipoort and releases the loonheffingen payment through Rabobank.
Signals and correction returns stay on an open list until closed.
in_practice.human_gate: The payroll specialist sends each return and each correction. A green check does not file by itself. The payment of loonheffingen needs the same human release as the salary batch.
data_needed: Closed payroll totals by wage-tax component
Employee identification fields required on the loonaangifte
Prior-period return and open Belastingdienst signals
Ledger balance for loonheffingen payable
Whether the werkkostenregeling final levy is inside this return or handled at year end by finance
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS loonaangifte log, Digipoort receipt, and the filing checklist on SharePoint

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit prepares the Dutch loonaangifte and submits it through Digipoort.
The monthly combined wage-tax return covers wage tax, employee insurance premiums and the employer Zvw contribution.
Employers remain responsible for an incorrect loonaangifte, so the send step is kept with a person.

risks: Auto-sending a return would put a wrong filing in the company's name. Wage-tax debts can become a management liability.
BSN and dates of birth on the return are high-risk personal data under AVG and do not belong in prompts or loose logs.
A correction that also changes an employee's jaaropgave can create a second wave of employee questions if it is sent quietly.
Headroom is limited because AFAS already does the filing; a new tool that only duplicates the AFAS wizard will not pay back.
research_questions: How many Belastingdienst signals and rejected returns did Noordhaven have in the last twelve months, and what caused them?
Is the werkkostenregeling final levy filed from payroll or calculated by finance at year end?
What does the specialist still check by hand that AFAS does not already flag before send?

tasks.short: Send pension changes and answer UWV and insurer wage requests.

today.trigger: A joiner, leaver, hours change or long-term sickness must be reported to the pension fund, or UWV or an insurer asks for wage data.
steps: Prepare the pension messages from AFAS for the transport fund and for the warehouse scheme.
Fix employees the fund rejects: hours threshold, part-time percentage, pensionable wage, or sick status.
Keep the collective health-plan census and any disability-insurance list in Excel when those sit with payroll.
When UWV asks for wage data for WW, Ziektewet or WIA, pull history from AFAS and send it back before the deadline.
Answer fund and insurer mail that does not match the monthly file.
drudgery: Rekeying joiners and leavers the payroll system already knows
Maintaining a second census spreadsheet for an insurer
Searching old periods for a UWV wage request under deadline
today.time_sinks: Fund rejections and one-off UWV requests arrive as portal errors and letters, while the monthly payroll calendar does not leave a gap for them. Flex workers on agency contracts are a frequent false trail.

lenses.faster: The pension file is checked before it is sent, and a UWV letter becomes a draft wage table from AFAS instead of a search through old payslips.
lenses.autonomous: Each hire, leave and contract change queues a pension mutation, and each UWV or insurer mail opens a case with its deadline.
lenses.ambitious: At a tenth of the cost every joiner and leaver would be reported to the fund in the same week, and wage history for WIA and the Wet verbetering poortwachter file would be ready before HR asks.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses typing the same person into a fund portal and a census sheet. What remains is a disputed pensionable wage or a colleague waiting on a UWV deadline.
lenses.options: For a long-term sick employee the draft can show pensionable wage under the fund's continued-accrual rule and under a stop-accrual rule, so Compensation and Benefits can confirm which one the scheme uses.
lenses.altitude: The specialist keeps the participation rules and the test cases for both schemes, and checks exceptions and outgoing figures rather than retyping them.
reach: The compensation specialist's monthly pension participation list and collective health-plan census
The wage history the HR business partner needs for a Wet verbetering poortwachter or WIA file
The HR administrator's new-hire and leaver messages to the pension fund

tasks.human_edge: Pension and UWV figures become someone's benefit later. The specialist checks odd contracts — min-max hours, part-time, long sickness — before a message leaves, and does not let a draft invent a wage.
tasks.pattern_why: The monthly pension file is structured, but fund rejects and UWV letters are messy and the reply must be right before it is sent. An agent can prepare the file and the draft reply; the specialist approves both.

in_practice.trigger: A hire, leave, hours change or long-term sick record is saved in AFAS, or a wage request arrives from UWV, a pension fund or an insurer.
steps: Build the uniform pension message from AFAS for each scheme and pre-check hours, age, part-time percentage and pensionable wage.
Park fund exceptions on a list the specialist clears.
The specialist approves the pension send.
For a UWV or insurer letter, match the person and draft the reply using only AFAS wage figures, with the deadline on the case.
The specialist checks every figure and sends the reply.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves each pension file and each external wage reply. Draft figures that do not trace to an AFAS period are blocked.
data_needed: Pensionable wage, hours, part-time percentage, hire and leave dates
Which CAO and which fund applies
Long-term sick status as the fund requires it
Wage history for the periods a UWV request names
Collective health-plan or disability-insurance census, if payroll still keeps it
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS pension-message log and a case folder on SharePoint with the request, the reply and the send date

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit can send pension participation data with the Uniforme Pensioenaangifte.
Pensioenfonds Vervoer is the industry pension fund generally linked to CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer; a company warehouse CAO can use a different scheme.
UWV asks employers for wage data when assessing WW, Ziektewet or WIA, while basic health insurance is held by the employee, not administered as a US-style plan.

risks: A wrong pensionable wage is a long-tail claim the employee may notice only years later.
Sick status on a pension message is health data; the case folder must stay restricted under AVG.
Agency flex workers are employed by the staffing firm; reporting them to Noordhaven's fund would be a serious error.
A draft reply that fills a gap with a guessed wage is worse than a late reply. Untraced figures have to be blocked.
If the fund portal still requires rekeying, the gain is in the exception list, not in pretending the portal has an interface.
research_questions: Which pension fund is configured for the transport CAO, which scheme for the warehouse CAO, and does AFAS already send both by UPA?
How many UWV and insurer wage requests arrived last year, and how many hours did each take?
Which census lists does payroll still keep in Excel, and which of those already belong to Compensation and Benefits?
What share of fund rejects in the last year were data errors versus real rule exceptions?

role.altitude: The payroll specialist becomes the owner of Noordhaven's pay control system: both CAOs as rules in AFAS Profit, the checks that run before money moves, the map from wage components to the ledger, and an exception path the controller can follow. Monthly rekeying and shadow workbooks move into that system. The job is to change the rules when a CAO or a site practice changes, and to keep the sign-off honest.
reach: Bookkeeper: clear salary batches, loonbeslag and payroll suspense on the bank and the ledger
Accountant: tie out wage-tax and pension payables and prepare the loonaangifte review
Controller: produce the payroll section of the month-close pack
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: calculate cost and sample net pay for a CAO increase or a new allowance
HR Administrator: check mass joiners, leavers and scale changes before they hit the run and the pension file
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: keep one set of pay definitions in the Power BI model
FP&A Analyst: supply a weekly wage-cost flash by site and component
HR Business Partner: provide sick-pay and wage-history figures for a Wet verbetering poortwachter file, without taking the conversation with the employee
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks are about 480 hours a year, roughly 30% of this role as scored. The rest is employee questions, final pay, attachments of earnings, audits, the May holiday-allowance run and the annual jaaropgaven, and those peaks stay even when the monthly match is faster. One specialist can take the mechanical tie-outs now spread across a bookkeeper and an accountant, and can prepare CAO back-pay numbers for Compensation and Benefits. The same person cannot take the controller's sign-off, corporate tax, FP&A's whole forecast, or the HR business partner's talks with managers and the works council. Releasing the salary file and sending the loonaangifte remain personal approvals, so a slice of every cycle stays.
skills_to_grow: AFAS payroll configuration: wage components, correction runs, loonaangifte and pension messages, with test employees for both CAOs
Turning a CAO article into a rule that can be tested on warehouse and driving contracts
Reconciliation and ageing across Rabobank statements and the payroll ledger accounts
Control design with the controller: what auto-clears, what is sampled, and what is signed
Shared pay definitions in the existing Power BI model with the people-analytics analyst
AVG practice for BSN and sickness-related pay, including when a DPIA and works-council consent are required
role.ambitious_version: Payroll gets every own employee the right gross, net and payslip in the first month, including night work, overtime and sick pay under both CAOs, and a retroactive increase is a checked calculation rather than a fire drill. Wage-tax and pension messages leave from the same closed payroll, payroll accounts stay aged, and site managers and FP&A see labour cost by site and component every week. The specialist's month is rules, exceptions and the cases that do not fit: attachments of earnings, final pay, long-term sick pay and disputed hours. A new hire is not still repairing their pay at day 90.
